verdict.rationale: Mercury's invoicing page documents creating, sending, and tracking invoices, plus recurring invoices and branding, and Books pulls invoicing data into the ledger automatically. Nothing in the evidence shows online payment options for the payer or view/paid status notifications, and "track" is not explained. Invoicing is also documented on Mercury's broader platform rather than as a Books-specific feature. Missing for 10: documented online payment methods (card/ACH pay links) on invoices, invoice viewed tracking, paid-status notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid
